schema.title: schema
schema.description: A schema (ADR 0003): a schema name, a file path, or a mapping in the schema language.

reference.title: schema reference
reference.description: A schema name (Task) or a file (./schemas/task.yaml#/Task) (ADR 0002 section 2).

then.title: refused form
then.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): 'null' and type arrays are refused; nullability is 'nullable' (ADR 0003 section 5). Fix: write one type and 'nullable: true'.

then.title: refused form
then.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): inline value lists are refused because enums live in one catalogue, where each is declared once with its values, source and fallback. Fix: declare the values in the 'enums' catalogue and write 'enum: <EnumName>'.
A narrowing of a catalogue enum to a strict subset (ADR 0003 section 7).

reason.description: Optional docs: why the use narrows the enum.

oneOf.description: A mapping from tag value to variant (ADR 0003 section 3).

then.title: refused form
then.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): 'true' and 'false' are refused because direction decides strictness. Fix: remove it, or set 'unknownKeys' on the input use (ADR 0003 section 4).

format.description: A portable format (uuid, date-time, date, int64, decimal, email, uri, uri-reference) or a named format of the 'scalars' catalogue.

opaque.description: Any JSON value, not checked here, with the reason (ADR 0003 section 2).

file.description: A file: a multipart field or a download (ADR 0003 section 2).

default.description: On an optional input property or query field only (ADR 0003 section 10).

examples.description: Values parsed against the schema at compile time.

nullable.description: The value may be JSON null (ADR 0003 section 5).

codeName.description: The identifier generated code uses for the property.

$schema.title: refused
$schema.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): the dialect is fixed by seampact and the authoring schema. Fix: remove '$schema'.

$id.title: refused
$id.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): a schema's identity is its catalogue name; a second identifier would be a second fact. Fix: remove '$id' and use the schema's catalogue name.

$anchor.title: refused
$anchor.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): names live in the catalogue. Fix: declare the schema in the 'schemas' catalogue and reference it by name.

$dynamicRef.title: refused
$dynamicRef.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): generic, late-bound schemas have no counterpart in any target's type system. Fix: reference a named schema with '$ref'.

$dynamicAnchor.title: refused
$dynamicAnchor.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): generic, late-bound schemas have no counterpart in any target's type system. Fix: declare the schema in the 'schemas' catalogue and reference it by name.

$vocabulary.title: refused
$vocabulary.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): the vocabulary is fixed. Fix: remove '$vocabulary'.

$comment.title: refused
$comment.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): YAML comments serve; a '$comment' would reach no output. Fix: write a YAML comment ('# ...') or a 'description'.

$defs.title: refused
$defs.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): named schemas live in the 'schemas' catalogue, one place. Fix: move each definition into the 'schemas' catalogue and reference it by name.

anyOf.title: refused
anyOf.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): an untagged union cannot be decoded by a client without trying each branch, and validators disagree on overlaps. Fix: use 'oneOf' with a 'discriminator', 'nullable: true', or an opaque value with its reason.

not.title: refused
not.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): negative constraints have no native form in Bean Validation, Laravel or Symfony constraints. Fix: state the accepted values positively (an enum, a pattern, a range).

if.title: refused
if.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): conditional validation is not portable and hides two types in one. Fix: use a tagged union ('oneOf' with a 'discriminator').

then.title: refused
then.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): conditional validation is not portable and hides two types in one. Fix: use a tagged union ('oneOf' with a 'discriminator').

else.title: refused
else.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): conditional validation is not portable and hides two types in one. Fix: use a tagged union ('oneOf' with a 'discriminator').

dependentSchemas.title: refused
dependentSchemas.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): conditional validation is not portable and hides two types in one. Fix: use a tagged union ('oneOf' with a 'discriminator').

prefixItems.title: refused
prefixItems.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): tuples map to no record or class type. Fix: use an object, or an opaque value with its reason for a third party's tuple.

contains.title: refused
contains.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): no native counterpart in most targets; no consumer. Fix: remove 'contains'; check the item schema with 'items'.

patternProperties.title: refused
patternProperties.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): key-dependent schemas map to no type. Fix: use a map: 'additionalProperties: <schema>' with 'propertyNames'.

unevaluatedItems.title: refused
unevaluatedItems.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): direction decides how unknown fields are treated. Fix: remove it; input refuses unknown items and output tolerates them.

unevaluatedProperties.title: refused
unevaluatedProperties.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): direction decides how unknown fields are treated. Fix: remove it, or set 'unknownKeys' on the input use (ADR 0003 section 4).

const.title: refused
const.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): a one-value field is an enum or a union tag; keeping both would give two ways to state it. Fix: use a catalogue enum, or a union tag.

uniqueItems.title: refused
uniqueItems.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): no native, exact check in Bean Validation or class-validator, and "equal" differs for objects; no consumer. Fix: remove 'uniqueItems'; the handler deduplicates.

maxContains.title: refused
maxContains.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): 'contains' is refused. Fix: remove 'maxContains'.

minContains.title: refused
minContains.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): 'contains' is refused. Fix: remove 'minContains'.

maxProperties.title: refused
maxProperties.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): no consumer; map size limits wait for one. Fix: remove 'maxProperties'.

minProperties.title: refused
minProperties.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): no consumer; map size limits wait for one. Fix: remove 'minProperties'.

dependentRequired.title: refused
dependentRequired.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): conditional presence. Fix: use a tagged union ('oneOf' with a 'discriminator').

contentEncoding.title: refused
contentEncoding.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): base64 inside JSON has no consumer; files travel as multipart parts or downloads. Fix: use a file field of a multipart input, or a file download.

readOnly.title: refused
readOnly.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): they make one schema stand for two types; a payload that differs between input and output is two schemas. Fix: declare two schemas, the input one derived with 'pick' or 'omit'.

writeOnly.title: refused
writeOnly.description: Refused (ADR 0003 section 1): they make one schema stand for two types; a payload that differs between input and output is two schemas. Fix: declare two schemas, the input one derived with 'pick' or 'omit'.

default.description: On an optional input property or query field only (ADR 0003 section 10).

examples.description: Values parsed against the schema at compile time.

nullable.description: The value may be JSON null (ADR 0003 section 5).
